summary_md:
# 270. Back to basics

**Feed**: aktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-08-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 270 returns to stock-picking after macro-heavy episodes, opening with concern over US 'higher for longer' rates driven by an unsustainable US fiscal deficit and rising debt-service costs, then covering Nvidia's blowout guidance (70% growth next year at ~20x earnings) and a batch of Swedish reports. The core of the show is four bullish stock cases: Axfood, Nibe, Octave (the Hexagon spinoff) and Plejd, all pitched as attractive, with weaker verdicts on Actic, Smart Eye (high-risk), Ellos and Sivers. Overall constructive on quality growth names despite an uneasy macro backdrop.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AXFO — Axfood | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Defensive grocer; easier comps, improving market growth and City Gross turnaround; ~4% dividend yield.

#### Reasoning

After share weakness, three tailwinds line up: comparison bases ease (diskrepancy peaked Q2 2025), market growth has improved, and loss-making City Gross is improving quarter by quarter toward group-level margins. Solid #2 grocer with ~4% yield; positives outweigh negatives, ~20% one-year upside if it works.

#### Sell Triggers

- if City Gross fails to turn profitable
- if capex/investment levels stay elevated and drain cash flow
- if Axfood keeps growing below market

> *"menar då att kursraset kan vara ett bra läge att kliva på den här defensiva aktien"*

---

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

9% growth with standout margin improvement from completed investments; deleveraging opens M&A; H2 stronger than analysts expect.

#### Reasoning

Heavy investment period is over, lifting factory efficiency and margins with volume help. Improving profitability eases debt, opening the balance sheet for acquisitions — a new trigger. Management guides for a normal seasonal pattern with stronger H2 organic growth, ahead of analyst estimates; sequential improvement should restore confidence despite a still-high valuation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sequential organic growth fails to accelerate in H2
- if US consumer weakness deepens
- if margin gains reverse

> *"H2 kommer bli starkare. Så Q3 och Q4 borde bli högre organiskt tillväxt. Och där är inte riktigt analytikerna idag."*

---

### 🟢 PLEJD — Plejd | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Electricians' first choice on easy wireless install; Sweden +21% Q2; broadened product range; office LED fixtures next market; ~20x, below peers.

#### Reasoning

Operationally firing on all cylinders with few question marks. USP is installation ease making it electricians' default, supporting pricing. Broadened product portfolio and strong install rate on core markets; mature Sweden still +21% in Q2, faster abroad. Office/commercial LED ceiling panels are a large new market. Trades ~20x operating profit, low for 20% organic growth versus peers often at 30x; international expansion is the added optionality.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Swedish install growth decelerates below ~20%
- if international expansion (Norway, Netherlands, Germany) fails
- if construction recovery stalls

> *"Bolag som växer 20 procent organiskt hittar man ju sällan till låga multiplar."*

---

### 🟠 SEYE — Smart Eye | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Automotive +100% but slight miss; 85m cash, falling burn; EU DMS mandate from 7 July drives demand; explicitly high-risk.

#### Reasoning

Fell 30% on report after a strong summer; automotive grew over 100% but missed growth and profitability marginally, raising cost-runaway fears (past dilution memory). Cash ~85m with burn dropping to 25-30m/quarter gives ~3 quarters runway; ~54% total growth plus new EU DMS legislation mandating driver-monitoring in new cars from 7 July is a structural demand driver. Single-digit multiples if analyst estimates hold, but explicitly a high-risk case.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth stalls before operating leverage kicks in
- if cash burn forces another dilutive rights issue
- if DMS demand ramp disappoints

> *"Som sagt, det är verkligen ett högrisk-case."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Tough summer; 42 insider sells vs 5 buys in 6 months, net insider ownership -400m; hosts sarcastic about prospects.

#### Reasoning

Considered bottom-fishing given the weak summer, but insider behaviour is a clear negative signal: 42 insider sells versus 5 buys over six months and a net -400m change in insider ownership ('they flee with all they can'). Hosts are dismissive/sarcastic about the company's 'opportunity pipeline', implying little conviction in a near-term turnaround.

#### Sell Triggers

- if insider selling continues
- if fundamentals fail to improve

> *"Ja, de flyr med allt de kan. Nettoförändringen i insiderägandet är minus 400 miljoner."*

---

### 🟡 EKTA-B — Elekta | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Headline beat 15-20% but boosted by tariff refunds (~1.5pp margin); reiterated 12.5-13.5% margin guide; not growing with market; stock down.

#### Reasoning

New CEO's first report beat headline estimates but ~1.5pp of gross margin came from tariff refunds; adjusted, results were only okay versus last year. Guidance reiterated (12.5-13.5% operating margin vs ~12% last year), CEO admitting they are not growing in line with the market — a negative flagged by a down share price. Persistent lack of US organic growth keeps the hosts cautious; want to see the new product take hold.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US organic growth stays absent
- if new product launch is poorly received
- if margin guidance is missed

> *"Vd:n sa också att de inte växer i linje med marknaden. Det är väl kanske en negativ indikator."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Beat again; CFO guided ~70% revenue growth next year vs ~44% expected, trades ~20x earnings; only concern lower gross-margin guide.

#### Reasoning

Beat estimates every quarter since Q3 2022; initial negative reaction to softer gross-margin guidance reversed after CFO guided ~70% revenue growth next year, nearly double the ~44% analysts expected — extraordinary for the world's most valuable company. At ~20x earnings it isn't expensive; key question is whether the earnings level is sustainable given the AI/chip supercycle, with large installed datacenter base needing chip replacement supporting durability.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI capex supercycle rolls over
- if chips become commoditised and pricing falls
- if growth fails to sustain current earnings level

> *"nästa år förväntar vi oss att växa med ungefär 70 procent. Vilket är helt ofattbart för ett sånt här stort bolag."*

---

### 🟠 ATIC — Actic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Like-for-like sales +8% but EBITDA (ex-IFRS16) halved, margin 30%->14%; up 450% in 3 years; hosts undecided.

#### Reasoning

Decent top-line with 8% like-for-like growth and comparable-unit EBITDA +39%, but overall EBITDA ex-IFRS16 halved and margin fell from 30% to 14%, showing difficulty ramping new facilities. After a 450% three-year run (and a spectacular move from ~6.50 to 37 kr), hosts explicitly say 'I don't know' on whether it's a buy — no conviction either way.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new-facility profitability keeps dragging group margins
- if like-for-like growth slows

> *"Är det här en köpkandidat? I don't know."*

---
